title: Design System: KSI Safety Edge RC Native

ksi-accent.displayName: Field accent, not a safety verdict

native-system-sans.purpose: Actual sp sizes and selected/medium variants live in native views and Widget.Ksi.Button; no CSS rem/px equivalence is claimed.

ksi-title.purpose: TextAppearance.Ksi.Title declares 20sp sans-serif-medium; the mission empty-state heading uses the same 20sp role via text(). Preparation and section headings use the 16sp role.

ksi-section.purpose: TextAppearance.Ksi.Section, 16sp sans-serif-medium. Section headings; verified in styles.xml.

ksi-body.purpose: TextAppearance.Ksi base, 14sp sans-serif. Default body text; header tabs also use 14sp.

ksi-label.purpose: TextAppearance.Ksi.Label, 12sp muted. Status lines, badges, and secondary facts; site rows allow up to 3 lines.

ksi-button.purpose: Widget.Ksi.Button, 13sp sans-serif-medium with 48dp minHeight touch floor. Preparation pending indicator also uses 13sp but is disabled display-only text, never a command.

narrative.northStar: A clear video-first observation surface that works with the physical controller.
narrative.overview: 이 문서는 현행 Android의 시각 어휘와 적용 범위다. 현재 구현을 전문가 수준으로 인수했다는 문서가 아니다. 제품 의미/사용자 결정은 AGENTS.md의 정본, 제품 맥락은 PRODUCT.md, 전체 화면 검토는 docs/verification/rc-design-review.md를 따른다. 구체 표면 전략은 도구로 연결된 현행 브리프에 둔다.
keyCharacteristics: 영상과 실제 과업이 먼저 읽히고, 상태·조작·근거 상세의 무게가 구별된다.
물리 RC와 앱은 역할을 나눈다. 모든 물리 조작을 상시 버튼 목록으로 복제하지 않는다.
현행 수치·배치는 검증된 범위의 기준선이지, 사용자 피드백보다 우선하는 영구 규칙이 아니다.
dos: Do judge the whole screen: hierarchy, grouping, density, alignment, action recognition, and the scene left visible.
Do separate native render evidence, simulated state transitions, adapter wiring, physical operation, and user acceptance.
Do preserve source-labelled unknown/stale/error states and existing command, data, and permission boundaries.
Do use actual native resources and the current matched brief; compare them with fresh evidence before extending the UI.
Do record design-only input and verification provenance in reports or metadata; meet asset licences and distinguish simulated from real data in connected apps.
donts: Don't treat a reference element's presence, a passed layout test, or a Critic with no findings as professional design acceptance.
Don't restore historical web recipes, rejected layouts, or fixed round-specific dimensions as permanent design authority.
Don't invent live video, maps, telemetry, REC, photo success, or preservation receipts to make a screen look complete.
Don't let a disconnected camera adapter become a claimed complete camera experience through static bench labels.
Don't add prototype badges, repeated disclaimers, or synonymous replacements to an isolated design-only screen.
